confidence.high: Entity exists, country agrees and coordinate is within 25 km.
confidence.medium: Entity exists and coordinate is within 25 km, but country metadata is absent or uses a territorial parent.
confidence.low: Entity exists but country/coordinate evidence is incomplete or coordinate is 25–100 km away.
confidence.rejected: Entity is missing, QID is duplicated, or coordinate is more than 100 km away.

reason: Wikidata P17 may describe a sovereign parent while the dataset uses a dependent-territory ISO code.
